claim_limit: The synthetic-only engine inventories fixture roots globally before payload streaming, reconciles cross-root hardlinks, verifies candidate members and payload relationships, and extracts bytes into a distinct-device mode-0700 quarantine. The fixture source and candidate share one temporary device; only the quarantine used a separate disposable APFS image. The verifier writes a local temporary SQLite spool, so read-only applies to candidate storage rather than all host writes. Quarantine mode was checked; ACL grants were not qualified. No production capture factory, source/candidate device separation, owner-scale replay, real T, Kingston K, owner/protected closure, application consistency, clean-host Brain restore, activation, or erase authority is qualified. Symlink materialization and xattr/ACL/flag restoration are not implemented; the historical .git waiver remains unresolved custody only.
